hypothesis: A deterministic per-claim participant-completeness validator with bounded one-shot repair converts the V15 uncertainty FAIL into a PASS without regressing the comparison or drug-sensitivity PASS outcomes, producing a full-panel PASS on the exposed cases.
null_hypothesis: The validator/repair mechanism either fails to convert the uncertainty case or introduces a regression on a previously passing case.
stop_condition_lift_authorization: Full exposed panel PASS in one run.
intervention_description: Add a per-claim participant-completeness validator and bounded one-shot repair to the existing claim-framing path. No prompt-content changes.
intervention_constraints: No change to the V15 system prompt or any prompt content.
No change to event types, source-general rules, or relation types.
No change to the shadow planner, inventory completeness reviewer, or claim-adjudication contracts.
No access to the 7 preserved fresh cases until full-panel PASS is demonstrated.
Repair call count per incomplete frame: exactly 1.
Repair call is receipt-logged with the same custody invariants as the initial call.
No silent retry. No silent fallback to a different model.

execution_authorized_only_if: This preregistration is committed and pushed before any provider call.
Exposed panel case set is identical to V15.
Fresh cases remain untouched and inaccessible.
Provider budget ceiling is explicitly set and logged.
execution_not_authorized_if: Any prompt-content change is introduced without a new preregistration.
Fresh cases are accessed before full exposed-panel PASS.
Repair call count exceeds 1 per incomplete frame.
